0022600006.text: The 76ers, who are 1-0 and first in the Atlantic Division after a road win, host the Cleveland Cavaliers in their second game of the 2026-27 season, and Cleveland has not yet played a game this season. Philadelphia lost all four meetings with Cleveland in 2025-26, including a 115-101 loss in Cleveland on March 9, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27. Ariel Hukporti and Dominick Barlow are out for Philadelphia, Dean Wade and Tacko Fall are day-to-day, Nae'Qwan Tomlin is out for Cleveland, and Khalifa Diop and Sam Merrill are day-to-day.
